cenas.fala: Let me show you CYRON at work, just like you'd use it on your phone. This is an alliance server, with players from Indonesia, Japan, China and Latin America.
When someone new joins, the first thing they see is the language channel. Budi is from Indonesia. He taps the menu, picks Bahasa Indonesia, and that's it.
Right away, CYRON opens his room. And look at our English channel: she announces the newcomer in every room, each one in its own language.
Now I just type normally, in English, like in any chat. Anyone joining the bear at eight?

Notice: I didn't type any command. Since I'm an admin, I can open the other rooms. In the Indonesian room, my message is already there. In the Chinese room too. And in the Spanish room. Always with my name.
Now Budi replies, in his own room, in Indonesian. And here's how it reaches me: in English, showing who he replied to.
Stickers come through too. Mika sent one, and it shows up small, next to the text. And an emoji from another server is drawn right below the message.
Now a trick that works in any channel. Yuki wrote in Japanese. I hold my finger on the message, pick the British flag, and the translation lands in my DMs.
Announcements are even easier. Under every announcement there's a menu. Budi taps it, picks Indonesian, and gets a translated copy only he can see.
In events, everyone sees the time in their own time zone. I tap sign up, and before it starts, CYRON reminds me in my DMs.
And admins control everything in the CYRON channel. Open the menu and turn each feature on or off, like the heroes that pop up in chat.
And right now, during the beta, all of this is free. Add CYRON to your server. The link is in the bio!
